title: Quick guide — Clinical engineering KPIs
what: Here you follow the process month by month: availability, maintenance and costs. The traffic light tells you if you are on track, should watch, or must act.
can_do: Fill in the month (or pull counts from inventory)
See the traffic light and the year summary
steps: Choose company and year, then click Load.
Complete the month (or click Apply inventory to month) and save.
Read the colours: red needs an action in the plan (who, what, by when). Export Excel if you need it.

common_errors.fix: Save the month and click Load again.
Check the company and that inventory has devices.
You can view but not type. Ask ADMIN for access.

tips: Close the month with a comment, not colour alone.
Green meets the target, yellow watch, red act.
Update targets in Parameters before comparing the month.
Inventory columns are suggested for you; engineering fills the rest.
contact: If you cannot see your site or people are missing, write to your organisation ADMIN.
